test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to sequentially fill in the blanks marked [E1], [E2], [E3].
solution:
The correct answer is '**sweet, skinny, old**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjectives should be arranged in the correct order according to the standard English adjective sequence (opinion, size, age, shape, color, origin, material, purpose).
 
• In this case, "sweet" (opinion) comes first, followed by "skinny" (size/shape), and finally "old" (age).
 
• "**Sweet, skinny, old**" is the correct order because it follows the natural adjective sequence in English.
 
• Other options do not follow this sequence correctly.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Old, skinny, sweet: Incorrect because "old" (age) should not come before "skinny" (size) and "sweet" (opinion).
 
• Skinny, old, sweet: Incorrect because "sweet" (opinion) should come first.
 
• Sweet, old, skinny: Incorrect because "skinny" (size) should come before "old" (age).
